story.title: Handmade with love
story.text: My small business started off as a little hobby to make hats and scarfs for my family holiday. Little did I know it would turn into a daily joyous need to create beautiful unique items for you. All items are handmade by me with lots of love and I hope you enjoy shopping with me as much as I have loved crocheting for you. <3 xx
